requirements.title: The listed procedure categories are pure procedures
requirements.definition: A pure procedure is a simple procedure, a specified pure intrinsic or intrinsic-module procedure, a procedure defined by a pure subprogram, a dummy procedure or procedure pointer specified PURE, a type-bound procedure bound to a pure procedure, or a statement function that references only pure functions and contains no VOLATILE variable designator.
